title: Todd Combs - Investing, The Last Liberal Art
summary: In this episode, Todd will share lessons learned across the full arc of his career, beginning in the halls of the Florida state regulator and all the way through to the great plains of Omaha, Nebraska, home of the eternal compounder. Warren Buffett and Charlie Munger are two of the greatest business minds in history with an eye for talent and character. If we were to sum up this class into a single topic, it would be exploring what these two investing giants saw in Todd to select him out of the almost 8 billion other people in the world.
